id: \bGary: Well \PN, looks like we finally get to battle it out.
en: \bGary: Well \PN, looks like we finally get to battle it out.
it: \bGary: Bene, \PN, sembra che finalmente ci affronteremo.

id: \bMay the best Trainer win, which will be me of course.
en: \bMay the best Trainer win, which will be me of course.
it: \bChe vinca l'Allenatore migliore, cioè io, ovviamente.

id: \bGary: Well, I guess I lost. Good job \PN. I suppose you have some skill after all.
en: \bGary: Well, I guess I lost. Good job \PN. I suppose you have some skill after all.
it: \bGary: Beh, a quanto pare ho perso. Bel lavoro, \PN. Dopotutto un po' di talento ce l'hai.

id: \bYour next match will be held in the Silver Stadium again whenever you are ready.
en: \bYour next match will be held in the Silver Stadium again whenever you are ready.
it: \bIl tuo prossimo incontro si terrà di nuovo nello Stadio Argento, quando sarai pronto.

id: \bI'm excited to get started. Let's not waste any time.
en: \bI'm excited to get started. Let's not waste any time.
it: \bNon vedo l'ora di cominciare. Non perdiamo tempo.

id: \bYou did good. I suggest trying out for the Hoenn League.
en: \bYou did good. I suggest trying out for the Hoenn League.
it: \bTe la sei cavata bene. Ti consiglio di provare la Lega di Hoenn.

id: \bYou placed in the Top 8 this year. Come back next year to try again. Thank you for competing.
en: \bYou placed in the Top 8 this year. Come back next year to try again. Thank you for competing.
it: \bQuest'anno sei arrivato tra i migliori 8. Torna l'anno prossimo per riprovarci. Grazie per aver partecipato.

id: \bHarrison: Good to see you again. Let's see if I can beat you again, even if you're the Monarch now.
en: \bHarrison: Good to see you again. Let's see if I can beat you again, even if you're the Monarch now.
it: \bHarrison: Che piacere rivederti. Vediamo se riesco a batterti di nuovo, anche se ora sei il Monarca.

id: \bYou did good. Good luck with the finals.
en: \bYou did good. Good luck with the finals.
it: \bHai fatto un bel lavoro. Buona fortuna per la finale.

id: \bGary: Well \PN, looks like we get to battle it out here again.
en: \bGary: Well \PN, looks like we get to battle it out here again.
it: \bGary: Bene \PN, sembra che ci toccherà sfidarci di nuovo qui.

id: \bI had some time off from research and heard you were going to challenge the Silver League again, so I thought, why not?
en: \bI had some time off from research and heard you were going to challenge the Silver League again, so I thought, why not?
it: \bAvevo un po' di tempo libero dalle ricerche e ho sentito che avresti sfidato di nuovo la Lega Argento, quindi ho pensato: perché no?

id: \bMay the best Trainer win, which will be me, of course. Even if you're now the Monarch!
en: \bMay the best Trainer win, which will be me, of course. Even if you're now the Monarch!
it: \bChe vinca l'Allenatore migliore, cioè io, ovviamente. Anche se ora sei il Monarca!

id: \bGary: Well, I guess I lost. Good job \PN. I suppose you really have some skill now.
en: \bGary: Well, I guess I lost. Good job \PN. I suppose you really have some skill now.
it: \bGary: Beh, a quanto pare ho perso. Bravo \PN. Ora sì che hai un po' di talento.

id: \bHi there! It's an honor to be defending my title as the Silver League Champion against the Monarch!
en: \bHi there! It's an honor to be defending my title as the Silver League Champion against the Monarch!
it: \bSalve! È un onore difendere il mio titolo di Campione della Lega Argento contro il Monarca!

id: \bAww man! You're really strong after all.
en: \bAww man! You're really strong after all.

id: \bYes! Though I'm sure there were reasons for your loss, I appreciate the time you took to battle me.
en: \bYes! Though I'm sure there were reasons for your loss, I appreciate the time you took to battle me.
it: \bSì! Sono sicuro che c'erano dei motivi dietro la tua sconfitta, ma ti ringrazio per il tempo che hai dedicato a lottare con me.
\bCongratulazioni per aver vinto la Conferenza Argento!
